# WAS_mme_gaussian_process { #wass2s.WAS_mme_gaussian_process }

```python
WAS_mme_gaussian_process(
    random_state=42,
    cv_folds=5,
    n_clusters=4,
    kernel_options=None,
    n_restarts_optimizer_options=(0, 2),
    max_iter_predict_options=(100, 200),
    max_train_samples=1500,
    hpo_method='grid',
    n_random_iter=10,
    n_trials=20,
    timeout=None,
    n_jobs=-1,
    optuna_n_jobs=None,
    cv_n_jobs=-1,
    warm_start=False,
)
```

Gaussian Process Classifier MME (multiclass via One-vs-Rest in sklearn).

Rigorous scientific implementation:
  - Spatial clustering based on historical predictand coherence.
  - Spatio-temporal subsampling.
  - **Grouped Cross-Validation (by Time)** to prevent spatial-autocorrelation data leakage.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [compute_hyperparameters](#wass2s.WAS_mme_gaussian_process.compute_hyperparameters) | Computes best hyperparameters. Uses rigorous GroupKFold by Time. |
| [compute_model](#wass2s.WAS_mme_gaussian_process.compute_model) | Fit models on train set and predict on test set. |
| [forecast](#wass2s.WAS_mme_gaussian_process.forecast) | Train on entire history, forecast for 1 new time slice. |

### compute_hyperparameters { #wass2s.WAS_mme_gaussian_process.compute_hyperparameters }

```python
WAS_mme_gaussian_process.compute_hyperparameters(
    Predictors,
    Predictand,
    clim_year_start,
    clim_year_end,
)
```

Computes best hyperparameters. Uses rigorous GroupKFold by Time.

### compute_model { #wass2s.WAS_mme_gaussian_process.compute_model }

```python
WAS_mme_gaussian_process.compute_model(
    X_train,
    y_train,
    X_test,
    y_test,
    clim_year_start,
    clim_year_end,
    best_params=None,
    cluster_da=None,
)
```

Fit models on train set and predict on test set.

### forecast { #wass2s.WAS_mme_gaussian_process.forecast }

```python
WAS_mme_gaussian_process.forecast(

```

Train on entire history, forecast for 1 new time slice.
